summary: Prosperity Bancshares filed an 8-K announcing completion of its acquisition of Stellar Bancorp effective July 1, 2026. Each Stellar share was converted into 0.3803 Prosperity shares plus $11.36 cash, implying a total per-share consideration valued using a $71.44 reference price for Prosperity stock. Stellar stock options were cashed out based on the per-share merger consideration value. The merger was structured as a tax-free reorganization with Prosperity as the surviving entity, followed by a bank merger into Prosperity Bank. The deal closed with no disclosed regulatory hurdles; future updates may address integration milestones and accretion.
